visual.pie: Biosphere 2, Arizona: materially closed in theory, leaky in practice

turnos.t: Unit 1.2, systems. A system is a set of interrelated parts, and the connections between them and their environment, that form a complex whole with emergent properties.

Characteristics that appear only when the parts interact. No part has them on its own. A living organism is made of molecules that are not alive. Predator–prey oscillations and starling flocks are emergent properties of ecosystems.
